proof_body:
by
  intro K L _ _ _ _ _ _ p _ h P hP _
  have hG : IsGaloisGroup (L ≃ₐ[K] L) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K) (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) := IsGaloisGroup.of_isFractionRing _ _ _ K L
  have h1 := Ideal.ncard_primesOver_mul_ramificationIdxIn_mul_inertiaDegIn p (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L) (L ≃ₐ[K] L)
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdxIn_eq_ramificationIdx p P (L ≃ₐ[K] L), Ideal.inertiaDegIn_eq_inertiaDeg p P (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] at h1
  have hPb : P ≠ ⊥ := Ideal.ne_bot_of_liesOver_of_ne_bot h P
  haveI : P.IsMaximal := hP.isMaximal hPb
  rw [Ideal.ramificationIdx_eq_ramificationIdx' p P h, Ideal.inertiaDeg_eq_inertiaDeg' p P, ← IsGalois.card_aut_eq_finrank, ← h1]
target_source: ∀ (K L : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [Field L] [NumberField L] [Algebra K L] [IsGalois K L] (p : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers K)) [p.IsMaximal], p ≠ ⊥ → ∀ (P : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)) [P.IsPrime] [P.LiesOver p], (p.primesOver (NumberField.RingOfIntegers L)).ncard * (p.ramificationIdx P * p.inertiaDeg P) = Module.finrank K L
